card.name: Dosing tables before treatment duration
card.fires_on: Spaces and partway-through-word spots in dosing tables, just before a length of treatment (such as 7 to 14 days) or an infection name. It also fires inside drug names and indication words such as Uncomplicated or Recurrent.

modes.label: Gap before days
modes.description: The space after a dosing interval, right before the number of days of treatment.
modes.example: 500 mg every 12 hours<< >>5 to 7 days Typhoid

modes.label: Inside indication words
modes.description: Partway through words like Recurrent or Uncomplicated that name the infection in a dosing row.

modes.label: Inside antibody or antibiotic names
modes.description: Partway through long drug names in clinical text.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like duration, severity and shortened.
card.plain: It marks spots in dosing tables where a treatment length or duration is expected next.
